nodes.label: Structured Document as the Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: Directly co-editing HTML strings is structurally fragile under conflicting deletion and content changes, so a versioned Document Model is the sole data source and HTML is derived output.
nodes.norm_label: structured document as the source of truth

nodes.label: Unify All Changes as Document Operations
nodes.rationale: Converting GUI, Markdown, AI, and future collaborative edits into small common operations enables Undo, diffs, review, and audit history through one mechanism.
nodes.norm_label: unify all changes as document operations

nodes.label: Separate Renderer from Editing UI
nodes.rationale: A deterministic renderer preserves identical display and output for identical input, while external editor overlays prevent selection frames and controls from contaminating artifacts.

nodes.label: Build Correctness Before AI and Collaboration
nodes.rationale: AI and collaboration cannot merge changes safely until the document model and basic operations support reliable single-user editing, saving, and restoration.
nodes.norm_label: build correctness before ai and collaboration

nodes.label: Prioritize a Constrained Slide Model
nodes.rationale: The project prioritizes dependable post-generation editing over complete compatibility with arbitrary HTML or PowerPoint.
